name: ADCS Enum COM (SA)
help: Enumerate AD Certificate Services CAs and templates using ICertConfig/ICertRequest COM interfaces
long_help: Enumerates Active Directory Certificate Services (ADCS) infrastructure using COM interfaces (ICertConfig2, ICertRequest2, IX509CertificateRequestPkcs7). Lists all CA configurations in the enterprise, their certificates, web enrollment servers, and certificate templates with enrollment/name flags, EKU, and permissions. Requires enrollment rights on the CA to enumerate templates. Alternative to sa-adcs-enum when Win32 API access is restricted.
